backup.restore_point: PENDING - fill-restore-point.mjs stamps the newest COMPLETE backup (60 minutes or less) right before the apply
backup.production_rule: Expand only: one unique index (cleaner_rate_schedule property_id + effective_from; the four production rows already satisfy it), an append-only trigger and an audit trigger on public.cleaner_rate_schedule, and eight functions (seven RPCs plus the trigger function). No column, no table, no data change, no new telegram_pending kind. Existing rate rows are never touched. restore_point and verified_at are placeholders: take a fresh backup, re-read the clock, then fill both with fill-restore-point.mjs. Take a fresh backup if the one named is more than an hour old at apply time.

steps.name: run_compensating_script
steps.action: Apply supabase/rollbacks/20261006_d301_pay_rates_tasks.sql with run-sql-on-host.sh: it drops the seven RPCs, the two triggers on cleaner_rate_schedule, the trigger function and the unique index. Rate rows added through the new RPC stay (history). Roll the admin dashboard Pay rates and Tasks pages and the Cascade Staff Tasks and Pay rates screens back too.

feature_flags.name: sql_then_apps
feature_flags.required_state: Apply this release BEFORE publishing the admin dashboard build that has the Pay rates and Tasks pages and BEFORE the Cascade Staff build with the Tasks tab and the Pay rates screen: they call these RPCs and show an error until they exist.

compatibility.rehearsal: PENDING on a restored backup. Lane evidence: the suite supabase/tests/database/d301_pay_rates_tasks.sql (101 assertions, including the rollback body; three added after the audit, not yet re-run) passed 98/98 before that against an in-process PostgreSQL (pglite) carrying stubs of the auth, staff-access, audit and redaction helpers and a pgTAP shim; the migration also re-applies cleanly. The orchestrator must still run it as real pgTAP on the rehearsal.
compatibility.evidence: Production read-only (2026-10-06): cleaner_rate_schedule holds four rows (1900-01-01, 2026-01-02, 2026-05-07, 2026-09-30) with no duplicate (property, date), no foreign key points at it, and nothing in the repo updates or deletes its rows; staff_pay_rate_v1 already reads the row in force on the clean date. follow_up_tasks, work_orders and verifier_findings keep their columns; the new functions only read them and update status columns the existing save_* RPCs already update. Old writers (Telegram bot, submit-cleaning, save_follow_up_v1, save_work_order_v1) are untouched.

stop_conditions: any forward verification query returns anything other than its expected value
the restore point is older than one hour
restore_point or verified_at is still empty or still the PENDING placeholder
the rehearsal has not run the pgTAP suite green on this commit
the admin dashboard or the Cascade Staff build is published before this release is applied
